errors.text_span: Die schwarze Linie startet bei etwa 40 % mit 20 Jahren
errors.evidence: The black line starts at approximately 55% at age 20, not 40%.

errors.text_span: Die hellblaue Linie startet bei etwa 80 % bei 20 Jahren
errors.evidence: The light blue line starts at approximately 75% at age 20, not 80%.

errors.text_span: bleibt bis etwa 60 Jahre relativ stabil bei rund 90 %
errors.evidence: The dark blue line fluctuates mostly between 80% and 92% until age 60, with the average being closer to 85%. Stating that it remains stable at 'around 90%' is an overstatement, as it only briefly peaks above 90%.
